title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode12 The Courage I Need

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. I'm sorry you had to go through something so awful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I'm sorry...for just unloading on you like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't you worry about that. I think this calls for a glass of warm milk with plenty of honey.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How are you feeling? Any better?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After An shared her dream with me, I decided to sing as best I could...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I just wasn't serious enough about it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After all that, I haven't been able to change one bit...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's not true at all.
Just look at how much this is bothering you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len's right. The fact that you're worrying so much about this is proof that you want things to change—that you're trying desperately to open the next door.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's right. I made up my mind that I'd go listen to that song again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I've got to open the door!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whether you're going to stop here or step through that next door is up to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think your true feelings are, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The first time I sang at the cafe was so fun.
My heart was racing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I just can't get that feeling out of my head.
That's why I was so happy when An invited me to team up with her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't help but wonder how great it would be to chase after a dream together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, no matter what happens or what anyone says to you, there is no need to change those feelings you already have.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They are yours and nobody else's.
They're precious, and I think they are worth cherishing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to sing with An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And together, I want to put on an event that will surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to go tell An!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good luck! We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
MEIKO... Len...
Thank you so much, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like one of them was able to find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're right. And it would seem Untitled is one step closer to becoming a song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope we'll be able to sing it with them soon!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've got to change even more...so An and I will be able to put on the greatest event ever.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Looks like we're getting low on whiskey.
I'm going to grab some from the back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can see that she read my messages, but she still hasn't responded...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to look after Kohane like I should have. So much for telling her I'd help her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was really looking forward to teaching her more about this town and watching her enjoy all the events...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, Dad! I need to go see Kohane so I can—
